name: pacman
meets: foreign PAC GHOST    # caught, or eaten when frightened: the game decides

scripts.name: still_right
scripts.note: against a wall: his mouth stays as it was

scripts.name: still_up
scripts.note: against a wall: his mouth stays as it was

scripts.name: still_left
scripts.note: against a wall: his mouth stays as it was

scripts.name: still_down
scripts.note: against a wall: his mouth stays as it was

lines.note: tell the game: he is gone

scripts.name: parade
scripts.note: entry: the title show starts it; he runs across, the ghost after him

above: Pac-Man: chomping his way, still against a wall, dying, running on the title.
The game moves him from the middle of a cell to the next (dgx_ge_walk.h) and tells him his way.

params.name: way
params.note: the way it goes now: frightened, it keeps it for after

scripts.name: walk
scripts.note: on its way, whichever it was

scripts.name: fright

lines.note: tell the game: the fright is over

scripts.note: blue for a while, then flashing; the game makes it slow

scripts.name: eyes
scripts.note: eaten: only its eyes go home, it meets nothing

scripts.name: parade
scripts.note: entry: the title show starts it; after Pac-Man

above: A ghost: its way (its eyes look it), frightened and flashing as the fright ends, its eyes alone going home.
The four are one kind: the game draws each with its colors (param who: the palettes PINKY, INKY, CLYDE).

scripts.name: blink
above: Words on the screen: the prompt of the title blinks.

scripts.name: schedule
above: The schedule of the ghosts' modes, level 1: a signal to the game as each begins. The game starts it
with a life (an actor of its own, not drawn) and holds it while the ghosts are frightened.

params.name: eaten
params.note: dots and energizers eaten on this level

params.name: bonus
params.note: what the next ghost of this fright is worth

scripts.name: ready
scripts.note: READY! for a while, then the game goes

lines.cond: score >= EXTRA_LIFE and score - DOT_SCORE < EXTRA_LIFE
lines.note: the score passed it just now

lines.cond: score >= EXTRA_LIFE and score - ENERGIZER_SCORE < EXTRA_LIFE

scripts.name: fruit_comes
scripts.note: under the house for a while

lines.cond: score < EXTRA_LIFE or score - bonus >= EXTRA_LIFE
score >= EXTRA_LIFE and score - FRUIT_SCORE < EXTRA_LIFE

scripts.name: bonus_life
scripts.note: once a game: the score passes EXTRA_LIFE only once

scripts.name: cleared
scripts.note: the next level: the game lays the dots again

above: The game itself as an actor: its numbers and what follows from what Pac-Man eats. The game tells it
what was eaten and reads the numbers (PACMAN_PLAY_PARAM_*); the pause dialog shows them. Its signals:
SIG_NUMBERS the numbers changed, SIG_LEVEL the level cleared, SIG_OVER no lives left, SIG_GO READY! is
over (the timer ready), SIG_FRUIT the cherry comes, SIG_FRUIT_GONE it is gone (the timer fruit), SIG_NEW a new
game (the game lays the dots and the actors anew).

dialogs.name: pause
dialogs.text:
dialog pause
roles play PLAY
game PLAY
style menu
pause
    say game "PAUSE  Score {score}  Lives {lives}"
choose play
    "Continue" -> resume
    "New game" -> restart
label resume
    end
label restart
    tell play restart
    end
